# DunRite Construction Group

> Florida concrete and shell contractor delivering slabs, block walls, full shell packages, and large-scale concrete across 10 Central Florida counties.

DunRite Construction Group is a family-run shell and concrete contractor serving builders, developers, and homeowners across Central Florida. Services include slabs and flatwork, block and walls, full shell packages, and developer-scale concrete.

- [The Build](/): Cinematic walkthrough of a Florida build — slab to shell to delivered, with services, service area, and contact info.
